As such, it intersects with the… 43390777 involvement-of-members-of-the-rab-family-and-related-small-gtpases-in-autophagosome-formation-and-maturation involvement members rab family related small gtpases autophagosome Macroautophagy, the process by which cytosolic components and organelles are engulfed and d Involvement of members of the Rab family and related small GTPases in autophagosome formation and maturation Macroautophagy, the process by which cytosolic components and organelles are engulfed and degraded by a double-membrane structure, could be viewed as a specialized, multistep membrane transport process. As such, it intersects with the exocytic and endocytic membrane trafficking pathways. A number of Rab GTPases which regulate secretory and endocytic membrane traffic have been shown to play either critical or accessory roles in autophagy. The biogenesis of the pre-autophagosomal isolation membrane (or phagophore) is dependent on the functionality of Rab1.
